scope: Independent source/script review and offline re-read of completed P3 r3 CPU component and actual-wave evidence; no build or solver was started by this reviewer.
source: Authoritative source_r2: JSphCpu.cpp e652bcde2672c3823a490591b8054c9e770d2b6785ae37ab3e3a02cd09edbbea, including the conditional legacy wrapper memset. The other two candidate source files and all build identities are bound by the authoritative receipt below.

identity_review.coverage: Authoritative source snapshots/programs; fresh final output manifests, run/comparison receipts and their programs; companion recipes/runtime snapshots and changed production source/object identities. Historical header trees were not redundantly rehashed.
identity_review.old_failures: Component r1 caught legacy wrapper zeroing; r2 caught the fixture's invalid DCEL bit packing. Fresh r3 fixes only cell packing/assertion on already repaired production r2. Earlier wave wrapper attempts remain sealed controls, not adopted physical results.

component_each_configuration.limits: Static cell tables and two manually constructed images; actual helper/ct and C ownership are tested, but no component integration, real RunPeriodic creation or physical theory is claimed.

wave_each_configuration.limits: Half runs save every second integration step: exactness and independent half comparisons cover all257 declared saved states, not a claimed513-state actual/audit comparison. Actual full Run output scheduling/native BI4 export is not part of this harness.

independently_recomputed_half_metrics.original_limits_unchanged: 5 Pa pressure RMS and .005 mm material displacement at every declared actual matched saved time.

reference_and_effect.independent_offline_method: Reconstructed the loaded-material four-state discrete and continuum linear matrices from frozen symbols, then evaluated their eigendecomposition exponential at all257 times; no compiled reference program was run.
reference_and_effect.interpretation: Dynamic and diffusion terms are genuinely nonzero and the implementation follows the declared discrete mode. Approximately6.20 percent endpoint pressure discrepancy from continuum remains finite-neighbor spatial error; a tiny time-half error is not1-percent physical accuracy. No simple undrained atan-phase formula is imposed on the dynamic mode.

schema_caveats: Comparison JSON ULP/count arrays are populated only for the p2 descriptive branch. Zero arrays in half/rho receipts do not mean bitwise equality; this reviewer independently checked their binary changes.

Actual-only completion rate-audit/budget fields are zero because stage instrumentation is off. Evidence is taken from the same-trajectory audit with all declared saved states exact; zeros are not extra conservation proofs.

Lstar budgets and pressure/q power remain diagnostics, not exact mass or energy identities; the full-support quadratic balance residual identified in the earlier consistency screen remains unresolved.
decision: No remaining critical implementation defect was identified in this bounded private CPU stage. Selectively checkpoint the three candidate source files and required text evidence; retain failed attempts. Do not publish a dynamic XML/GPU/formal capability from this result. Resolve the first-step/FixedDt/DtMin and new coupled/operator time-step policy described in upl_p3_time_review_r1.json before public activation, then proceed through separately justified physical cases and compatibility gates.
